issues.on_page: p6 'Other' row: Bond Interest and Retirement Fund 14,686 is the only non-eliminated amount (Total 14,686). The Bond fund schedule (p14) prints only '5000 Debt Services' 36,843,473 = 36,828,787 + 14,686. Statement of Activities (p2) Debt service 42,100,213 = 42,085,527 + 14,686
issues.issue: The pages identify this line as debt service: it is part of the Bond fund's 5000 Debt Services, and p2 includes it in Debt service. It belongs in a debt service category (likely interest/fees), not 'other'.

issues.extracted: ESU 18 'Contracted services' 7,480,305 (revenue, other charges for services); matching General Fund spending kept in full
issues.on_page: p6 'Contracted services' row: ESU 18 7,480,305, Reclassifications (6,648,493), Total 831,812. The Reclassifications expenditure side takes 32,149,602 out of function lines (Instruction 4,649,139; Support-Instruction 1,473,679; General administration 7,763,016; Central services 6,939,464; O&M 9,225,010; Transportation 1,704,294; Categorical 395,000) = 25,501,109 transfers + 6,648,493 contracted services
issues.issue: This is the only remaining double count. Detail revenue totals 746,379,236 and detail expenditures 680,717,991, against p6 totals of 739,730,743 and 674,069,498. Both gaps are exactly 6,648,493: General Fund payments to ESU 18 that the statement eliminates, recorded here as both General Fund spending and ESU revenue. The report doesn't label it a transfer, so keeping it with review is defensible. A fix would split 7,480,305 into 831,812 + 6,648,493 (both printed on p6) and widen the General Fund contra to -32,149,602.

issues.extracted: support services (contra -25,501,109, department 'Transfers hidden in function lines (contra)')
issues.on_page: p6 Reclassifications column spreads the eliminations over Instruction (4,649,139), Support services, Student transportation (1,704,294) and Categorical (395,000). 1115 Instruction - Career Academy Programs 2,183,586 / budget 2,369,920 (p8) matches the Cooperative 'Transfer from General Fund' 2,183,586 / budget 2,369,920 (p19) exactly
issues.issue: The amount checks out (26,227,871 p22 - 726,762 = 25,501,109 = 13,503,467 + 9,814,056 + 2,183,586), and with it General Fund expenditure items sum to 552,339,513 as on p22. Expenditure plus other financing ties to the printed 578,567,384. The open questions are where the contra sits: it puts all of it under support services, although at least 2,183,586 (the Cooperative transfer, apparently the whole 1115 Career Academy line) is instruction. So in detail, instruction is overstated and support services understated. The department is also not one of the schedule's groups, as the hidden-transfer rule requires.

issues.extracted: Cooperative 'Member Payments' 234,843 (computed) + detail[202] other financing 4,293,118; ESU detail[226] 'Co-op contracts' -4,293,118
issues.on_page: p19 Member Payments 4,527,961 (budget 6,073,749); p23 ESU Co-op contracts 4,293,118; p6 'Core services' ESU 4,293,118 reclassified (4,293,118); Other Governmental 'Transfers - other funds' 7,203,466 = 726,762 + 2,183,586 + 4,293,118; Other Governmental 'Reimbursements and other' 254,443 = 234,843 + 19,600
issues.issue: Checked and correct. The p6 Reclassifications column treats ESU 18's co-op contract payments as a transfer into the Cooperative Fund, and 4,527,961 - 4,293,118 = 234,843 agrees with p6's 254,443 non-transfer Cooperative receipts. Cooperative revenue items plus other financing = 6,731,147 and ESU expenditure items plus |other financing| = 15,207,986, both tying to the printed totals. The 234,843 residual isn't printed on its own line, and the whole 6,073,749 Member Payments budget sits on the residual. Note that p22 still counts all 4,547,561 as Cooperative receipts.
